    Interventions for smoking cessation (a treatment network)

    Source: R/data.R
    smoking_cessation.Rd

    Arm level results of 24 trials comparing four interventions for helping people stop smoking: no contact, self-help, individual counselling and group counselling. Two trials have three arms. A standard example for network meta-analysis. Larger cessation counts are better, so use small_values = "bad" in meta_network().

    Usage

    smoking_cessation

    Format

    A tibble with 50 rows (arms) and 7 columns:

    id

    Arm identifier.

    study

    Study identifier.

    authors

    Study authors.

    year

    Publication year.

    trt

    Intervention: "no_contact", "self_help", "ind_counseling" (individual counselling) or "grp_counseling" (group counselling).

    xi

    Number of people who stopped smoking.

    ni

    Number of people in the arm.

    Source

    Hasselblad, V. (1998). Meta-analysis of multitreatment studies. Medical Decision Making, 18(1), 37-43. doi:10.1177/0272989X9801800110

    Values cross-checked against dat.hasselblad1998 in the 'metadat' package.

    Examples

    meta_pairwise(smoking_cessation, study = study, treatment = trt,
  measure = "OR", event = xi, n = ni)
